streams.reasoning: From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Soluble reactants combined. Flow rate derived from calculation (Q_total = 0.5 mL/min) to achieve target residence time.

mixer_type: Static mixer or inline mixing tee
mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: All components combined simultaneously. Since catalyst is packed, only one liquid stream is fed.
pre_reactor_steps: Filter liquid stream A to remove particulates before entering packed bed.
post_reactor_steps: Collect effluent. Product may precipitate or require concentration.
chemistry_notes: Knoevenagel condensation using heterogeneous N-doped carbon catalyst. Batch time 24h reduced to ~113 min in flow via packed bed reactor (PBR) to prevent clogging (Chemistry Plan incompatible_pairs). Analogy 1 (glass column) supports PBR approach. Analogy 2 (immobilized catalyst) supports residence time scaling. No BPR required as T=50C < bp(MeCN)=82C. No light source needed.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Calculation Step 2 estimated 112.7 min based on kinetic IF=13x. Analogy 1 used 9 min (homogeneous/RT), Analogy 2 used 60 min (immobilized/RT). Our reaction is at 50C with heterogeneous catalyst; 112.7 min is conservative estimate for conversion.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Single phase liquid. Basis is V/Q.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Same as batch (50C) per Chemistry Plan. Analogy 1 used 25C, Analogy 2 used RT. Maintaining 50C ensures kinetics match batch baseline while leveraging flow efficiency.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation Step 8: BPR not required. T=50C is well below MeCN bp (82C).
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: Stainless Steel preferred for Packed Bed Reactor housing and pressure integrity, though glass columns (Analogy 1) are also viable. SS is standard for robust flow setups.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: 0.2 M from Batch Input and Chemistry Plan. Analogy 1 used 0.25 M, Analogy 2 used 0.2 M. Keeping 0.2 M to match batch solubility and kinetics.
